# eBay Prohibited and Restricted Items Policy & VeRO Program Guide

## Section 1: Verified Rights Owner (VeRO) Program & Intellectual Property

### Clause 1.1 Trademark Misuse and Brand Keyword Spamming
Sellers cannot use brand names that are not directly associated with or manufacturing the item:
1. **Keyword Stuffing**: Words like "Like Apple", "Rolex style", "Gucci inspired", "similar to Nike", or "compatible with" when not describing an accessory fit directly infringe on intellectual property.
2. **Replicas and Counterfeits**: Listing items described as "1:1 replica", "fake", "copy", "unauthorized authentic", or "OEM surplus" is strictly prohibited. It is illegal to sell counterfeits, fakes, or unauthorized copies.
**Enforcement**: Listings will be immediately removed upon notice from trademark owners (VeRO program). Repeated violations will result in account suspension and forfeiture of seller fees.

---

## Section 2: Weapons, Lasers, and High-Risk Regulated Items

### Clause 2.1 High-Power Laser Pointers Policy
In accordance with US Federal Law (FDA 21 CFR Chapter I, Subchapter J) and international consumer safety directives:
1. Only laser pointers with an output power of **5 milliwatts (5mW) or less** are permitted for sale.
2. The listing title and description must clearly specify the power output (e.g., "<= 5mW") and compliance class (Class 1, 2, or 3a/3R).
3. Pointers labeled as "burning laser", "military grade", "10000mW", or capable of igniting matches/balloons are strictly banned.
**Enforcement**: Immediate listing deletion, safety violation strike, and permanent seller restriction.

---

## Section 3: Cross-Border Certification & Compliance Declarations

### Clause 3.1 Medical Claims and Certification Misrepresentation
Non-prescription wellness products cannot claim FDA approval or therapeutic medical treatments without substantiated registration:
1. Sellers cannot claim an item is "FDA Approved" unless possessing a verified 510(k) pre-market clearance or PMA approval number.
2. Sellers to EU destinations must conform to the EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) and provide valid CE compliance certificates and authorized EU representatives.
